phases.label: 根拠確認
phases.prompt: Identify which claims require repository, tool, or current-state evidence. Use selected read-only discovery tools when the request concerns existing code or live state. Clearly distinguish verified facts from assumptions, and do not invent an architecture when the current implementation can be inspected.
